author: Unayaha
quote: The 30fps dips frequently and lets be real here, this is not a grand theft auto game, it’s way too slow, characters also aren’t as interesting as in 5, people say “oh you just never played red dead redemption 2 if you don’t like this direction” then in that case, why call it grand theft auto if you’re taking huge influence from a completely different game. Game is just boring and adds so much unnecessary things for the sake of “realism” such a shame because the actual map itself is good but there’s not much to do that’s actually fun or worth your time.
